concerns.text: FR-002 requires the system to normalize metabolite intensities and merge them with ASV tables. T001 aborts the pipeline if metabolomics data are unavailable, which means the merge step (T004) will never run, effectively weakening FR-002. The specification does not permit aborting due to missing metabolomics; the task list must ensure FR-002 is fulfilled or provide a documented fallback that still produces a merged dataset.

Constitution VII mandates that the predictive signal exceed R² > 0.3. No task includes a verification step that checks the observed mean R² against this threshold, so the requirement is untested. A guardrail or test asserting mean R² > 0.3 is needed to satisfy the constitution.
